findings.claim: RepairActionGenerator interpolates diagnosis.evidence['service'] directly into 'systemctl --user restart {service}'. _classify_risk returns LOW when the safe pattern occurs anywhere in the command, and RepairExecutor runs command with shell=True. A synthetic non-executing classifier replay shows 'systemctl --user restart frank.service; touch /tmp/SHOULD_NOT_RUN' remains LOW.
findings.current_head_crossread: Frozen Project-Frankenstein services/asrs/auto_repair.py exposes the same substring risk-classifier and shell execution design; this is not independent/new Drive architecture.
findings.scope_constraint: Exploitability depends on whether an attacker can influence crashed_services/service diagnosis data. The source proves unsafe command composition and classification semantics, not a demonstrated external compromise.
findings.required_oracle: Effect gateway must tokenize/type resources rather than classify a shell string; service identifiers require strict validation; no shell concatenation for internal restart action.

findings.claim: The module declares the core is ALWAYS non-empty / at least min_core_size, yet build_core() returns [] when no Titan nodes exist and also returns [] on exception. Even with candidates, slicing cannot synthesize missing members when candidates < min_core_size.
findings.required_oracle: Named invariant must be construction-checkable. Empty/startup/error states need an explicit UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE core state or a proven bootstrap seed; a docstring invariant cannot outrank executable state.

findings.claim: Triple Reality describes Primary and Shadow as independent runs with different seeds, but sync_shadow applies the same insert/update/delete operations to a shadow initialized from a database backup. rng_primary/rng_shadow/rng_validator are initialized, while the operational path shown does not use random choices except reseeding after divergence. Convergence distance therefore does not demonstrate independent stochastic replication.
findings.additional_contradiction: On divergence the documentation says rollback both to last convergent state; _rollback_to_convergent currently copies Primary -> Shadow and explicitly notes a full implementation would restore both from backup.
findings.required_oracle: Goodman/replication logic must distinguish cloned replay, deterministic differential execution and independent replication by ancestry/intervention identity. Never credit clone agreement as independent support.

findings.claim: The Drive copy documents a 2026-08-01 restart-loop failure: snapshot active/inactive collapsed systemd transitional states, causing the supervisor to restart a service while it was already activating/deactivating; the fix queries the real systemd state and skips activating/deactivating/reloading. lifecycle.py also removes rooms/nerd-physics and aura-analyzer from restart waves because 'start all' resurrected disabled/zombie services.
findings.required_oracle: Harness recovery suite must model ACTIVATING/DEACTIVATING/RELOADING separately from DOWN and must prove disabled/decommissioned components cannot be resurrected by global restart orchestration.

findings.claim: ContextGate is described as selecting among 15 context channels but eight named channels are hard-coded ALWAYS_PASS. Therefore those channels are not actually suppressible by the learned relevance gate; the learned/rule threshold applies only to the remaining candidate channels.
findings.required_oracle: Evaluate gate causal benefit on the actually gateable channels and report bypass channels explicitly. Never score the module as if it had selection authority over all 15 channels.

reuse.reason: PF safety/authority and recovery history already has mapped earned-work. This shard contributes stronger executable contradictions and post-head recovery oracles.
